title: 2834. Find the Minimum Possible Sum of a Beautiful Array

examples.explanation: We can see that nums = [1,3] is beautiful. - The array nums has length n = 2. - The array nums consists of pairwise distinct positive integers. - There doesn't exist two distinct indices, i and j, with nums[i] + nums[j] == 3. It can be proven that 4 is the minimum possible sum that a beautiful array could have.

We can see that nums = [1,3,4] is beautiful. - The array nums has length n = 3. - The array nums consists of pairwise distinct positive integers. - There doesn't exist two distinct indices, i and j, with nums[i] + nums[j] == 3. It can be proven that 8 is the minimum possible sum that a beautiful array could have.
We can see, that nums = [1] is beautiful.
